  },

    "path": "codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src/circuit_model_selection_owner_support_tests.rs",
    "reference_before": "127e9731d146a8a30b2f6cfa8b563f97afe694a8",
    "append": "\n#[path = \"circuit_resident_candidate_provider_material_support_tests.rs\"]\nmod resident_provider;\n",
    "integration": "ordinary appends on actual combined parent, preserving all previous mounts. Additional orchestrator children are separate additions; do not overwrite this frozen constructor."
  },
  "factories": [
    {
      "signature": "ProviderAdmission::new().await -> anyhow::Result<ProviderAdmission>",
      "public_to_parent": [
        "objective: Digest32",
        "trust_time: u64",
        "source_c: CircuitTaskSourceInputV1"
      ],
      "held_private": [
        "original A support::Admission",
        "separate actual C support::Admission"
      ],
      "note": "source previews are not RunStart or completion; original signed C request remains held"
    },
    {
      "signature": "UnstartedProvider::new(admission, evaluation_profile: Digest32).await -> anyhow::Result<UnstartedProvider>",
      "precondition": "construct PreparedBPanel with admission.objective/trust_time first; supply its registration().evaluation_profile(); do not change a signed initial profile later",
      "fields": [
        "trainer: Arc<OriginalCellQ24TrainingBootstrapOwnerV1<FileAnchorWitnessStore,FileAnchorWitnessStore>>",
        "material_owner: Arc<OriginalCellQ24MaterialCommandOwnerV1<FileAnchorWitnessStore,FileAnchorWitnessStore,FileAnchorWitnessStore>>",
        "material: OriginalCellQ24MaterialReceiptConfigV1",
        "baseline: Arc<LoadedCellQ24ModelV1>",
        "bundle: CellCompatibilityBundleV1",
        "definition: CellDefinitionV1",
        "ledger: Arc<Mutex<LedgerWriter>>",
        "credentials: material::Credentials",
        "previous: CircuitTaskSourcePublicationV1",
        "source_a: CircuitTaskSourceInputV1",
        "config_a: CellGenerationConfigV2",
        "a: Option<support::Session>",
        "c: Option<support::Admission>",
        "source_c: CircuitTaskSourceInputV1",
        "version: VersionFixture",
        "root: PathBuf"
      ]
    },
    {
      "signature": "UnstartedProvider::original_bytes(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<Vec<u8>>>",
      "note": "reads original source journal/witness even after A is taken, plus original ledger/material/training/baseline files; missing files remain error"
    },
    {
      "signature": "UnstartedProvider::finish(self).await -> anyhow::Result<[u64;4]>",
      "precondition": "join all external owners/services and release all extra Trainer/Material Arc clones first; if A was taken, caller owns its actual stop/join and retention of its home directory"
    }
  ],
  "observer_binding": "The existing enrolled credentials.observer is chosen before material::unstarted_material_with_profile freezes initial owners. The actual later C owner must use this same TrustedLearningSignerV1 and original fixture key43. SourceInput has no observer getter.",
  "preserved_c_request": "Before a later retained_version_task_inputs consumes C Admission, caller must preserve the actual C ingress needed for the actual new daemon. Do not substitute another request or support::start a second C factory.",
  "no_parent_source_edit_in_this_packet": true
}

# Fresh provider material builder — new reconstruction

This is an isolated test-only implementation of the previously missing Fresh material builder. It is a new source version over exact cc57, not a recovery of the unavailable 8,494/9,491-byte workspace drafts. The complete final source is `182285bb87ede5ed1cc0dcea7172f5ce3cd55224`.

It provides `ProviderAdmission::new` and `UnstartedProvider::new(admission, evaluation_profile)`. The parent mount is the existing model-selection owner-support test module's new `resident_provider` child. Ordinary remains the single integrator for that mount and the later orchestrator children.

## Actual input sequence encoded

The first factory obtains the original A admission and a separate original C admission. It computes the prospective A objective and C source preview while retaining both actual admissions and the actual C request. Preview alone creates neither RunStart nor completion. The caller creates PreparedBPanel from the objective/trust time and supplies its already fixed registration profile to the second factory.

The material factory creates the original loaded baseline, bundle and definition. It opens the existing original ledger with its enrolled test credentials, binds A's learning run before the existing support::start signs the complete request, starts that same A and executes it through the original ObjectiveStart path. It reads the actual original Cell/Source result and checks the baseline prediction.

The original decision and fixed independent 2Q terminal label then enter the same ledger. The value is fixed by the existing terminal_outcome helper, not copied from the prediction or a later Training result. Original unstarted_material_with_profile binds the actual A publication, Source, Ledger, baseline, frozen B profile and already enrolled C Observer before any Material or Training receipt is created.

The builder creates the real Material owners and consumes them into the actual Material command host. It holds four original internal connections: Dataset readback, material source, Experience evidence and Dataset evidence. The existing actual handlers serve them. It constructs the original Fresh Bootstrap from the real native/receipt files, witnesses, Generator key, baseline and these held connections. It performs no Material Execute, Training, Evaluation or Model operation.

This avoids using PositiveFixture's auxiliary positive Evaluation/Model flow as a new Root-chain result. It also avoids using DeepFixture's completed legacy three-cut NoUpdate as an evaluated four/five/six-cut result. Only its original unstarted construction pattern is reused.

## Same A, same C and Observer binding

The result retains A as an actual Session, the same Version fixture, original baseline and files, original ledger and material host, and C as its original unconsumed Admission plus source preview. The initial next_use_observer is the already enrolled credentials.observer principal from the original fixture. The later actual C owner must use that same trusted signer and fixture key43. SourceInput has no separate observer getter; no identity is guessed from C metadata or rebound after a signed cut.

The complete orchestrator still owns the actual same-A drain, FinalUse publication, C startup and original C ingress. In particular, it must preserve C's request before the original retained_version_task_inputs consumes the Admission. A second support::start must not substitute another C factory for an already installed daemon. The exact same-A/FinalUse/C source review is `13b0e243009e42e3dd6cc4612e3d4f2077a67d33`.

If the orchestrator takes A, it owns A's real stop/join and retention of A's original home directory until all dependent owners are closed. The builder retains the exact Source journal/witness paths unconditionally; original_bytes continues to read them after a.take. Missing originals remain errors instead of disappearing from the conservation check.

## Cleanup and preserved bounds

All Result errors after the actual Session starts drop partial clients, await the original A.stop, and join every already started Material peer. Normal finish closes its Trainer, reaps all four peers even if one reports an error, checks for outstanding external Trainer/Material owners, and retains the original directory until cleanup ends. External services must be closed before finish.

The Material peer guard also reaps its std threads during Drop and reports errors. The existing Session Drop only cancels its worker; no asynchronous worker-join result is claimed from Drop. A cancelled constructor or a caller that abandons explicit finish is not reported as successful lifecycle coverage.

Actual custody files are opened before the short evidence transports are started. This avoids putting extra fixture file creation inside their already running deadline; it changes no timeout. Source/evidence exchange limits remain500ms; the existing Dataset command adapter remains30s; channel lifetimes remain300s, original request bounds remain128, and the Bootstrap signature window remains300s. Public admission limits and all existing test budgets are unchanged.

## What is and is not complete

The single-file implementation, complete packet, original source references, exact mount/API contract and full Git readback are complete. No old source method or assertion is modified. The source is not formatted, compiled, executed or activated in a checkout. The source-text checks are not Rust type checking.

The file is a real mechanism-fixture proposal, with explicit test keys, trust, input label and same-UID internal ports. It is not a deployed ten-owner run, public four-slot success, a real independent B evaluation, utility gain, completed C execution or daemon/Root recovery. Those remain the responsibility of the combined orchestrator and original qualification workflow. Actual runtime, stack use, error cleanup and complete module integration must be checked under the unchanged original budgets.

The constructor itself adds no test method. The frozen B component `b7c1fd26ab52400f5105bcc227f0950a2b785900` and the full orchestrator are separate inputs. All existing source gates and real execution outcomes must be obtained after the combined source is reviewed and frozen.
